utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word and keep the repair drive plan clear for everyone on the block. I’ll check in with the others and circle back once I’ve talked to folks.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I’ll sort the donations and keep an eye on the tools. Let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll put together a quick supplies list for the repair drive, and I’ll make sure Oren gets the details so he can help. Mina’s set for 10 a.m., and Leo’s handling the donations list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’m still keeping the locations straight for the repair drive. If any new spots come up, I’ll note them so Rosa can keep each address together.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yep, I’ll sort the donations and keep an eye on the tools for the repair drive. Just remind me if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll head over to the community center and check in at the front desk. I’m also putting together a simple task list so we can keep the repair drive organized.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just send me the short list when you have it. I’m mainly watching for screws, duct tape, and one replacement hinge.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll send you a short list once I’ve got it together. I’ll keep an eye out for screws, duct tape, and a replacement hinge at the front desk.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll send Bo the repair details once I’m back from errands. I heard Mina can be there at 10 a.m., and Vik will check with the others and circle back.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll sort the donated tools and hand them out as folks arrive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, thanks — that’ll help a lot. I’ll get Bo the repair details as soon as I’m back.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the donations and see what’s already been dropped off for the repair drive. We still need screws, duct tape, and one replacement hinge.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but can you confirm the repair drive is still at the community center front desk before I tell anyone else?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, I can confirm that. I’ll check the donations and let you know what’s already been dropped off.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s coming together really well—folks keep dropping off tools and donations. Rey plans to stop by to help, and Jules is handling the task list and checking in at the community center front desk.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my drill and a few spare screws. Dane can hand tools out as folks arrive, and Leo can keep the missing hardware list up to date.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be a huge help, Gus—thank you! I’ll pass it along, and it sounds like we’re getting everything lined up nicely.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can work around school drop-off and pick-up times. Leo’s 9:30 to 11:30 window should be fine, and Hana can let us know if anything needs adjusting.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds perfect, Faye. I’ll keep rounding up extra hands and make sure everyone has the latest details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks, Sam. With Rey on standby and Hana checking the schedule, we should be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll stick to the repair-drive plan and bring the latest notes with me. Happy to help get the open items sorted.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Eli — I’m still waiting on the timing and pickup details before I can commit. Once Quinn sends the drop-off spot, loop me in and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Pia. I’ll wait for Quinn’s drop-off spot and then pass along the timing and pickup details right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Uli — I’ll keep an eye out for Mara’s repair drive details and do my part once they come through.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I’ll need the donations sorted and a missing-items list for the repair drive, if you can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll sort the donations and jot down a missing-items list for the repair drive as soon as Mara sends the details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — I really appreciate you helping sort the pile. I’ll stop by the repair drive and lend a hand if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, perfect — could you give me a quick update on the repair drive? I heard Cleo can check the supply list and Leo’s sorting the donations and making the missing-items list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds like we’re in good shape — Cleo checking the supply list and Leo sorting donations will help a lot. I’m coming by soon, and I can pitch in wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll add any missing hardware to the list. Gus has the drill and spare screws, and Cleo can check the supply list if needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks — I’ll share the full repair drive task list and confirm we’re starting at 10 a.m. today.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — send the task list when you can, and I’ll add any missing hardware.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll be there at 10 a.m. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mina — could you help group the repair drive notes by location and keep an eye on the Sunday setup at the community center? I’m putting everything in order now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I can group the notes by location and watch the Sunday setup at the community center. If you need extra hands, I can bring some too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll sort the donated tools and hand them out as folks arrive. If you’ve got the latest notes, I can keep the open items moving without any fuss.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I’ll keep asking for extra hands, and Eli should bring the latest notes to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect—once Eli gets here with the notes, I’ll keep the tools sorted and hand them out as people arrive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — can you confirm the repair drive is still at the community center front desk?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes — I’m still tracking the repair drive locations, and the community center front desk is the check-in spot.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — just confirming, it’s still at the community center front desk, right?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll be there at 10 a.m. What needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll put together a simple task list and head to the community center front desk to check in. Opal’s handling the drop-offs there, and Vik’s spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — send me the task list, and I’ll bring extra hands if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll put together the quick supplies list and check in with a few neighbors about donations. Let me know once you’ve got the missing-items list sorted.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m sorting the donations now and I’ll add any missing hardware to the list. I’ll send it over as soon as it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — send it over when you’re ready, and I’ll compare it with the supplies list and neighbor donations.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I might’ve missed the latest update — what’s the final time for the repair drive, and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the timing and pickup details before I can commit. Quinn said they’d send the drop-off spot too, so once that’s in I can confirm what I can help with.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll wait for the timing and drop-off spot update. If you hear anything, just let me know and I can bring whatever’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. I’m relying on Leo to sort the donations and make the missing-items list for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — what still needs to be brought in?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I still need the donations sorted and a clear missing-items list for the repair drive. I’m waiting on Leo for those details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the repair list and pickup times against the school schedule first, then I’ll confirm everything to Kira.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my drill and a few spare screws for the drive. Dane can hand them out as folks arrive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds good, Gus. I’ll verify the list and pickup times against the school schedule, then I’ll let Kira know the details are set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can work around school drop-off and pickup, and Leo’s 9:30 to 11:30 window should be okay for me. I’ll wait to hear back from Hana if anything needs adjusting.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Faye — I’ll check what’s already been donated and send a quick update on the repair drive. We still need screws, duct tape, and one replacement hinge.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Got it — I’ll keep that window open and can help if anything changes around school times. Thanks for the update on the screws, duct tape, and hinge.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s coming together really well — folks are dropping off tools and donations already. I’ll let Rey know if I hear they need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s great to hear, Tess — thank you. I’m keeping the notes in order, and the repair drive is still set for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds perfect — Sunday at the community center works. I’ll pass along any updates if I hear they need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — once I’m back from errands, I’ll send Bo the repair details. And Mina’s set for 10 a.m., right?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, that sounds right — I’ll keep an eye out for the repair details and do my part once they come through. Thanks, Ira.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks, Oren — I’ll send them as soon as I’m back. And I’ll let Vik check in with the others and circle back.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s set for 10 a.m. today—I’ll share the task list and the start time now, and send Pia the timing plus drop-off spot as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good—I’ll stop by around 10 and help where needed. If you see Gus, he’s got a drill and some spare screws, and he can help sort the pile too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Rey — 10 a.m. works, and Gus’s drill will be super useful. I’ll keep you posted if anything shifts and make sure Pia gets the timing and drop-off spot as soon as I have them.
